CandidateFeaturesRead.description: Facts computed by code (not AI) for one person and task.
CandidateFeaturesRead.title: CandidateFeaturesRead

DecisionRead.description: A decision the engine asks about each candidate (read-only; defined in YAML).
DecisionRead.title: DecisionRead

ExplanationRead.description: Every point cites numbered facts; `facts` lists them so the UI can show the evidence.
ExplanationRead.title: ExplanationRead

InterpretResponse.description: Fields understood from the message. Null = not stated; the chat asks for it.
InterpretResponse.title: InterpretResponse

TaskStatusChange.description: A manager closes a task (filled / cancelled) or reopens it. Never automatic.
TaskStatusChange.title: TaskStatusChange

TaskUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed. `requirements`, if sent, replaces the whole list.
TaskUpdate.title: TaskUpdate

get.description: How much manager feedback there is, and how much of it can train the model.
Training examples as JSON Lines, for `train_student.py --feedback` on Kaggle.

put.description: New cut-offs become a new version (audited); the next run uses them.

post.description: Turn a manager's free-text description into task fields for the chat to confirm.
Queue a match run; poll GET /match-runs/{run_id} until it completes.
Mark filled, cancel (reason required) or reopen. Audited; nothing is ever automatic.
